sloka: विश्वामित्र आश्रमे सौम्य सुखेन व्यतिचक्रमुः ।अथ काले गते तस्मिन् विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ॥१-६३-९॥
transliteration: viśvāmitra āśrame saumya sukhena vyaticakramuḥ ।atha kāle gate tasmin viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ॥1-63-9॥

translations.english: As the period passed, Viswamitra the mighty ascetic was filled with grief, anxiety and remorse.
